verdict.rationale: Discord's first-party docs describe slash commands as the most common type of application command, invoked by typing `/` in the chat input or opening the command picker. The docs also say developers can build commands that give users a native way to invoke their app, which matches the story's core. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the command registration API or process (global vs. guild registration, options schema), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register custom slash commands that users invoke from the message box

citations.quote: Slash commands are the most common type of command and are accessed by typing `/` in the chat input, or by opening the command picker.
Application commands provide users a native way to invoke an app in Discord. They often map to an app’s core features or functionality.
Build automated apps, commands, and integrations that run inside Discord servers.
